{
  "extractions": [
    {
      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "When the approximate timing of the need for leave is not foreseeable",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "When the approximate timing of the need for leave is not foreseeable, an employee must provide notice to the employer as soon as practicable under the facts and circumstances of the particular case."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "recommendation",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "When notice is of leave that is unforeseeable",
        "context_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "generally should",
        "modality": "should",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [
          "§ 825.303(c)"
        ],
        "statement": "It generally should be practicable for an employee to provide notice of unforeseeable leave within the time prescribed by the employer's usual and customary notice requirements applicable to such leave."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "permission",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "When the employee is unable to give notice personally",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "modality": "may",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F001",
        "choice_text": "spouse, adult family member, or other responsible party",
        "logic_quote": "F001",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "Notice may be given by the employee's spokesperson (such as a spouse, adult family member, or other responsible party) if the employee is unable to do so personally."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "If an employee's child has a severe asthma attack, the employee takes the child to the emergency room, and the child is receiving emergency treatment",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "would not be required",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "If an employee's child has a severe asthma attack and the employee takes the child to the emergency room, the employee would not be required to leave the child in order to report the absence while the child is receiving emergency treatment."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "scope_text": "If a child's asthma attack required only the use of an inhaler at home followed by a period of rest",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "If a child's asthma attack required only the use of an inhaler at home followed by a period of rest, the employee would be expected to call the employer promptly after ensuring the child has used the inhaler."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [],
        "scope_text": "",
        "context_quotes": [
          "F002"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "An employee shall provide sufficient information for an employer to reasonably determine whether the FMLA may apply to the leave request."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F002"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Depending on the situation",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "modality": "possible",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F002"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F002",
        "choice_text": "information may include that a condition renders the employee unable to perform the functions of the job; that the employee is pregnant or has been hospitalized overnight; whether the employee or the employee's family member is under the continuing care of a health care provider; if the leave is due to a qualifying exigency, that a military member is on covered active duty or call to covered active duty status (or has been notified of an impending call or order to covered active duty), that the requested leave is for one of the reasons listed in § 825.126(b), and the anticipated duration of the absence; or if the leave is for a family member that the condition renders the family member unable to perform daily activities or that the family member is a covered servicemember with a serious injury or illness; and the anticipated duration of the absence, if known",
        "logic_quote": "F002",
        "references": [
          "§ 825.126(b)"
        ],
        "statement": "Depending on the situation, information provided by an employee may include that a condition renders the employee unable to perform the functions of the job; that the employee is pregnant or has been hospitalized overnight; whether the employee or the employee's family member is under the continuing care of a health care provider; if the leave is due to a qualifying exigency, that a military member is on covered active duty or call to covered active duty status (or has been notified of an impending call or order to covered active duty), that the requested leave is for one of the reasons listed in § 825.126(b), and the anticipated duration of the absence; or if the leave is for a family member, that the condition renders the family member unable to perform daily activities or that the family member is a covered servicemember with a serious injury or illness; and the anticipated duration of the absence, if known."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F002"
        ],
        "scope_text": "When an employee seeks leave for the first time for a FMLA-qualifying reason",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "need not",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F002",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "When an employee seeks leave for the first time for a FMLA-qualifying reason, the employee need not expressly assert rights under the FMLA or even mention the FMLA."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F002"
        ],
        "scope_text": "When an employee seeks leave due to a qualifying reason for which the employer has previously provided the employee FMLA-protected leave",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F002"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F002",
        "choice_text": "either the qualifying reason for leave or the need for FMLA leave",
        "logic_quote": "F002",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "When an employee seeks leave due to a qualifying reason for which the employer has previously provided the employee FMLA-protected leave, the employee must specifically reference either the qualifying reason for leave or the need for FMLA leave."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": [],
        "scope_text": "",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "will not",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "Calling in “sick” without providing more information will not be considered sufficient notice to trigger an employer's obligations under the Act."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": [],
        "scope_text": "",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "The employer will be expected to obtain any additional required information through informal means."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [],
        "scope_text": "",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "has an obligation to",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "An employee has an obligation to respond to an employer's questions designed to determine whether an absence is potentially FMLA-qualifying."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F002",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F002"
        ],
        "scope_text": "If the employer is unable to determine whether the leave is FMLA-qualifying due to the employee's failure to respond to reasonable employer inquiries regarding the leave request",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "modality": "possible",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "Failure to respond to reasonable employer inquiries regarding the leave request may result in denial of FMLA protection if the employer is unable to determine whether the leave is FMLA-qualifying."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "requirement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F003"
        ],
        "scope_text": "When the need for leave is not foreseeable, absent unusual circumstances",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "must",
        "modality": "must",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F003",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "When the need for leave is not foreseeable, an employee must comply with the employer's usual and customary notice and procedural requirements for requesting leave, absent unusual circumstances."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "permission",
        "scope_quotes": [],
        "scope_text": "",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "modality": "may",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F003"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F003",
        "choice_text": "call a designated number or a specific individual to request leave",
        "logic_quote": "F003",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "An employer may require employees to call a designated number or a specific individual to request leave."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F003"
        ],
        "scope_text": "When the need for leave is not foreseeable, if an employee requires emergency medical treatment, until his or her condition is stabilized and he or she has access to, and is able to use, a phone",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "would not be required",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F003",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "If an employee requires emergency medical treatment, he or she would not be required to follow the call-in procedure until his or her condition is stabilized and he or she has access to, and is able to use, a phone."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F003"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In the case of an emergency requiring leave because of a FMLA-qualifying reason, when FMLA leave is involved",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may not be required",
        "modality": "possible",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "In the case of an emergency requiring leave because of a FMLA-qualifying reason, written advance notice pursuant to an employer's internal rules and procedures may not be required when FMLA leave is involved."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F003",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "statement",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F003"
        ],
        "scope_text": "If an employee does not comply with the employer's usual notice and procedural requirements, and no unusual circumstances justify the failure to comply",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "modality": "possible",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F003"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F003",
        "choice_text": "delayed or denied",
        "logic_quote": "F003",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "If an employee does not comply with the employer's usual notice and procedural requirements, and no unusual circumstances justify the failure to comply, FMLA-protected leave may be delayed or denied."
      }
    }
  ]
}

unit_attributes.scope_text: When the approximate timing of the need for leave is not foreseeable
unit_attributes.statement: When the approximate timing of the need for leave is not foreseeable, an employee must provide notice to the employer as soon as practicable under the facts and circumstances of the particular case.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When notice is of leave that is unforeseeable
unit_attributes.statement: It generally should be practicable for an employee to provide notice of unforeseeable leave within the time prescribed by the employer's usual and customary notice requirements applicable to such leave.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When the employee is unable to give notice personally
unit_attributes.choice_text: spouse, adult family member, or other responsible party
unit_attributes.statement: Notice may be given by the employee's spokesperson (such as a spouse, adult family member, or other responsible party) if the employee is unable to do so personally.

unit_attributes.scope_text: If an employee's child has a severe asthma attack, the employee takes the child to the emergency room, and the child is receiving emergency treatment
unit_attributes.statement: If an employee's child has a severe asthma attack and the employee takes the child to the emergency room, the employee would not be required to leave the child in order to report the absence while the child is receiving emergency treatment.

unit_attributes.scope_text: If a child's asthma attack required only the use of an inhaler at home followed by a period of rest
unit_attributes.statement: If a child's asthma attack required only the use of an inhaler at home followed by a period of rest, the employee would be expected to call the employer promptly after ensuring the child has used the inhaler.
An employee shall provide sufficient information for an employer to reasonably determine whether the FMLA may apply to the leave request.

unit_attributes.choice_text: information may include that a condition renders the employee unable to perform the functions of the job; that the employee is pregnant or has been hospitalized overnight; whether the employee or the employee's family member is under the continuing care of a health care provider; if the leave is due to a qualifying exigency, that a military member is on covered active duty or call to covered active duty status (or has been notified of an impending call or order to covered active duty), that the requested leave is for one of the reasons listed in § 825.126(b), and the anticipated duration of the absence; or if the leave is for a family member that the condition renders the family member unable to perform daily activities or that the family member is a covered servicemember with a serious injury or illness; and the anticipated duration of the absence, if known
unit_attributes.statement: Depending on the situation, information provided by an employee may include that a condition renders the employee unable to perform the functions of the job; that the employee is pregnant or has been hospitalized overnight; whether the employee or the employee's family member is under the continuing care of a health care provider; if the leave is due to a qualifying exigency, that a military member is on covered active duty or call to covered active duty status (or has been notified of an impending call or order to covered active duty), that the requested leave is for one of the reasons listed in § 825.126(b), and the anticipated duration of the absence; or if the leave is for a family member, that the condition renders the family member unable to perform daily activities or that the family member is a covered servicemember with a serious injury or illness; and the anticipated duration of the absence, if known.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When an employee seeks leave for the first time for a FMLA-qualifying reason
unit_attributes.statement: When an employee seeks leave for the first time for a FMLA-qualifying reason, the employee need not expressly assert rights under the FMLA or even mention the FMLA.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When an employee seeks leave due to a qualifying reason for which the employer has previously provided the employee FMLA-protected leave
unit_attributes.choice_text: either the qualifying reason for leave or the need for FMLA leave
unit_attributes.statement: When an employee seeks leave due to a qualifying reason for which the employer has previously provided the employee FMLA-protected leave, the employee must specifically reference either the qualifying reason for leave or the need for FMLA leave.
Calling in “sick” without providing more information will not be considered sufficient notice to trigger an employer's obligations under the Act.
The employer will be expected to obtain any additional required information through informal means.
An employee has an obligation to respond to an employer's questions designed to determine whether an absence is potentially FMLA-qualifying.

unit_attributes.scope_text: If the employer is unable to determine whether the leave is FMLA-qualifying due to the employee's failure to respond to reasonable employer inquiries regarding the leave request
unit_attributes.statement: Failure to respond to reasonable employer inquiries regarding the leave request may result in denial of FMLA protection if the employer is unable to determine whether the leave is FMLA-qualifying.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When the need for leave is not foreseeable, absent unusual circumstances
unit_attributes.statement: When the need for leave is not foreseeable, an employee must comply with the employer's usual and customary notice and procedural requirements for requesting leave, absent unusual circumstances.

unit_attributes.choice_text: call a designated number or a specific individual to request leave
unit_attributes.statement: An employer may require employees to call a designated number or a specific individual to request leave.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When the need for leave is not foreseeable, if an employee requires emergency medical treatment, until his or her condition is stabilized and he or she has access to, and is able to use, a phone
unit_attributes.statement: If an employee requires emergency medical treatment, he or she would not be required to follow the call-in procedure until his or her condition is stabilized and he or she has access to, and is able to use, a phone.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In the case of an emergency requiring leave because of a FMLA-qualifying reason, when FMLA leave is involved
unit_attributes.statement: In the case of an emergency requiring leave because of a FMLA-qualifying reason, written advance notice pursuant to an employer's internal rules and procedures may not be required when FMLA leave is involved.

unit_attributes.scope_text: If an employee does not comply with the employer's usual notice and procedural requirements, and no unusual circumstances justify the failure to comply
unit_attributes.statement: If an employee does not comply with the employer's usual notice and procedural requirements, and no unusual circumstances justify the failure to comply, FMLA-protected leave may be delayed or denied.
